message.reasoning_content: We need to determine charge(s) based on facts. Facts: Wang, party branch secretary, used position to receive bribes from Zheng, total 470,000 RMB. This is classic bribery by a state (party) official. The label list includes "受贿" (bribery) and also "利用影响力受贿" (using influence to accept bribes). The examples: earlier case with a non-state staff receiving bribes used "非国家工作人员受贿". For state staff, they used "受贿". Also there is "单位受贿" for unit, "单位行贿". Here it's an individual state official. So charge: 受贿. Also possibly "滥用职权"? He used position to receive bribes, but the act is bribery, not necessarily abuse of power. The facts only mention receiving bribes, not abusing authority to cause loss. So only "受贿". The list includes "受贿". So final answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>.
